sources.title: Baichuan-M3-235B
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: The official Baichuan-M3-235B model card presents the model as a medical-enhanced clinical-inquiry model, identifies Qwen3-MoE ancestry/acknowledgement, and uses Apache-2.0 licensing.

limitations.text: The historical transition from the earlier independent Baichuan2 foundation-model line requires separate earlier evidence and is not established by the M3 model card alone.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

targets.target: Verify Baichuan M3 medical specialization, Qwen3-MoE ancestry, licensing/deployment, and the historical transition from the earlier independent Baichuan line.
targets.finding: The M3 model card verifies medical specialization, Qwen3-MoE ancestry/acknowledgement and Apache-2.0 licensing; the earlier-to-current historical transition is only partially represented by this source.
